description: Postman helps people inspect and test HTTP requests. Learn methods, URLs, status codes, JSON and response checks through worked messages that do not need a live API. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
learningObjectives: Practise use variables for repeatable requests

seo.title: Postman Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Postman with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
